calibration_policy: Develop on a separate set; freeze advanced corpora before parameter tuning. Report corpus size and splits, sample uncertainty, failures and costs. Never infer human ratings or pilot results from a model judge.
latency_and_cost: Record median/p95 latency and actual usage by modality/provider. Set scenario budgets after A04 probes and before implementing advanced extractors; no universal invented USD or latency budget.
